watch.text: Forwards William Eklund (ankle), Warren Foegele (knee) and Andre Burakovsky (lower body) are out vs Calgary; Hayden Hodgson (groin) is day-to-day.
D Kevin Bahl is out for the season (Achilles surgery) and Jonathan Huberdeau (hip) is out; Martin Pospisil (upper body) is day-to-day after a hit from Chicago's Wyatt Kaiser.
LW Artemi Panarin (personal, missed 4 games) and D Erik Gustafsson (upper body) are day-to-day and expected back Monday at Montreal; not confirmed.
Montreal acquired C Dylan Larkin from Detroit on 11/22 (for Kirby Dach, G Samuel Montembeault, Hage and picks); he debuts vs LA tonight as the 2nd-line center.
Dylan Guenther (IR since Nov 11, 2-4 weeks) and D John Marino (15 games missed) are nearing returns from upper-body injuries; not confirmed for Winnipeg.
Clayton Keller (illness) missed Saturday vs Anaheim and is day-to-day for Monday.
Toronto has the most players on IR in the league and has lost 9 of 10; Kirill Marchenko (out since Oct 26) and Colton Sissons skated in non-contact jerseys Sunday; Jack Roslovic is day-to-day.
D Alexander Romanov is out with a torn ACL; D Ryan Pulock (lower body) is day-to-day.
Mathew Barzal returned Nov 14 after missing the start of the season.
C Sean Monahan (did not travel, projected back Nov 25) and Conor Garland (IR) are out with upper-body injuries.
Out: Anthony Mantha (throat fracture surgery), D Johnathan Kovacevic (high ankle sprain, 4-6 weeks from Nov 17) and D Seamus Casey (knee).
No. 1 D Quinn Hughes (27.8 TOI, upper body) misses the rest of the road trip, including tonight at SJ.
Beckett Sennecke (20.3 TOI) went on IR 11/21 and Leo Carlsson (19.8) is day-to-day, two top-six forwards out or doubtful at SEA.
Zach Hyman (illness) and Ryan Nugent-Hopkins listed out on ESPN's game page for Nov. 24 (expected back that day per MoneyPuck); status unconfirmed. Goalie Andersen on IR (knee) to ~Jan. 9.

401892775.summary: Ottawa is missing three forwards (Eklund, Foegele, Burakovsky), which covers some of the gap; Linus Ullmark (.937, 11-1-0) was first off at the morning skate and starts.

reasons.text: Senators forwards William Eklund, Warren Foegele and Andre Burakovsky are out.
Linus Ullmark was first off the ice at Monday's morning skate and is starting against Calgary.

401892779.summary: The Wild are without No. 1 D Quinn Hughes again tonight, which our ratings don't see; that covers part of the gap between our 68% and the market's 63% on Minnesota.

reasons.text: Quinn Hughes (hurt Thursday at Calgary; not a concussion) misses a second straight game tonight at SJ; next chance to return is Wednesday vs Utah.
Starting goalies not confirmed: Wallstedt projected for Minnesota; Nedeljkovic projected for San Jose by most sources (some list Askarov).
Moneyline opened at about Wild -1.0 goals and has drifted toward the Sharks, consistent with the Hughes news.

401892780.summary: Hyman and Nugent-Hopkins may miss the game and Edmonton's starting goalie is unconfirmed, which covers part of the gap; the rest is our Sagarin side (EDM +0.56) vs xG (VGK +0.06).

reasons.text: ESPN's game page lists Zach Hyman (illness) and Ryan Nugent-Hopkins as out for Nov. 24; other feeds call them day-to-day.
Starting goalies unconfirmed: Carter Hart projected for Vegas; Edmonton between Tristan Jarry and Devin Levi with Andersen on IR.
